skill.description: Clone, create, fork, and manage GitHub repositories, remotes, and releases.

memory.responsibility: Retain repository intent plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform local git state into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through github repository api while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose the minimum service operations required for the requested target; writes require an explicit preview gate.

stages: Confirm owner repository and requested operation
Inspect local branches remotes and status
Preview create fork or release changes
Fetch repository and remote state again

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
